ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be constant in prayer according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'arij highlights 'Dawam' (constancy) not merely as ritual repetition, but as a spiritual state of presence and mindfulness (Tajalli) that distinguishes the true believers from those who pray out of habit. This consistency is viewed as a prerequisite for the spiritual ascent described in the Surah's title, linking physical discipline with inner purification.
